# onetsolutions_image (Data Source)

Looks up an image to install instances with, by `id`, by `slug`, or by `os_name` and `os_version`.

A lookup by `os_name` and `os_version` can be narrowed by `language` and `os_architecture`.
Several matches are an error unless `most_recent = true`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The public Ubuntu 24.04 image.
data "onetsolutions_image" "ubuntu" {
  os_name    = "Ubuntu"
  os_version = "24.04"
  visibility = "public"
}

# The most recent private Debian 13 image of the project, such as a golden build.
data "onetsolutions_image" "golden" {
  os_name     = "Debian"
  os_version  = "13"
  visibility  = "private"
  most_recent = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The UUID of the image. Exactly one of `id`, `slug` and `os_name` is required.
- `language` (String) The language of the system, such as `fr-FR` (case-insensitive); empty for Linux images.
- `most_recent` (Boolean) When several images match, pick the most recently published one instead of failing.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `os_architecture` (String) The CPU architecture, such as `x86_64`.
- `os_name` (String) The operating system, such as `Ubuntu` or `Debian` (case-insensitive).
- `os_version` (String) The version of the operating system, such as `24.04` or `13`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.
- `slug` (String) The slug of the image, such as `ubuntu-2404`. Exactly one of `id`, `slug` and `os_name` is required.
- `visibility` (String) Where to search: `public` reads the public catalog only (no project needed), `private` the project's own images only; when unset, both are searched in the project.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the image was published (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) The description of the image.
- `is_windows` (Boolean) Whether the image is a Windows system.
- `min_disk_gb` (Number) The smallest disk it installs on, in GB.
- `min_ram_mb` (Number) The least memory it runs with, in MB.
- `name` (String) The display name of the image, such as `Ubuntu 24.04`.
- `requires_license_addon` (Boolean) Whether an instance installed with it must order a license add-on.
